payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all possible shift offsets between s and u, extracts overlapping equal-length substrings, counts matching characters to find maximum matches, then returns len(u)-max_matches as minimal edit distance.
payload.rationale: The solution performs an exhaustive search over all substring alignments, systematically exploring the search space of possible starting positions. Among the given subtypes, backtracking most closely describes a complete search that tries all possibilities, even though it uses loops instead of recursion.
